title: G7 summit: 'Pressure will be on leaders to show support for Ukraine'
summary: As G7 leaders meet in France this week, Iran and the peace deal signed with the US is likely to be in the spotlight. But with Volodymyr Zelensky in attendance, Ukraine is also set to be a major point of discussion, with leaders expected to show their support for the country in the wake of recent Russian attacks. France 24's Philip Turle has the latest.
